what: The player's held broadsword: a straight double-edged blade with a gold crossguard, drawn at the hip in the overworld and seen close in first person.

dims.basis: ART_DIRECTION held weapon 1.0-1.3u; replaced the old 1.25u sword, crossguard width ~0.32u from a hand-width grip

views.why: first-person view model at ~0.5m; blade silhouette and guard read at arm's length

style_notes: Low-poly diorama, palette steel #C8D0D8 / gold #D9A62E / dark leather #592F1A, no textures. Crisp blade facets, bevelled guard. Never: smooth shading, stacked-box blade, invented hues.
notes: Rebuilt from the old 110-tri box sword with bmesh lofts, selective bevels, weighted normals and a packed UV0.
